experiment: Read registered profile union tables directly
retention_decision: First exact-image control verified: CPU and query p99 are mixed; peak RSS is higher in all three pairs with disjoint ranges. Median ratios are 1.0134 CPU, 1.0052 RSS, 0.9639 query p99 and 0.9881 ingest p99. No consistent CPU/RSS/query advantage qualified. Confirm the same images and workload before retaining or rejecting; preserve every observation.

scope.change: Read the registered table through DataFusion table() instead of parsing SELECT *. Keep all columns, row order, partition remapping, source-symbol identity and Plan/Exec error categories.

profile_selection.interpretation: SQL planning under the hot/cold union collector appears in the diagnostic allocation capture. Counts include startup/seed; this is a selection hypothesis, not a gain.

fresh_baseline_capture.interpretation: Diagnostic image is 241b; the paired-control baseline is f4c5. Their profile binary, base layer, service config and all nonbinary files are identical. Only their inactive metrics-service binary differs.

negative_control.mutation: Limit each input table to one row.
negative_control.result: Exactly the complete batch ledger fails; 122 other pprof cases pass. Candidate source restored.

comparison_plan: Three fresh alternating baseline/candidate pairs on one private GCP VM, plus three native Pyroscope pairs. Steady 60-second workload, unchanged matched budgets. CPU and peak RSS include broker and MinIO. Verify seven application binaries and every nonbinary image path before dispatch.
limitations: Diagnostic captures are not normalized timing/resource gain evidence.
Single-node API-accepted workload; upstream durability contracts differ.

image_producer.identity_note: Archived config-digest is Docker inspect Id; OCI config digest comes from the independently verified image archive.

pairs.pairing: Three fresh baseline/candidate deployment pairs on one VM, alternating first revision; native comparison also retained separately.
pairs.scope: Single-node API-accepted steady load with identical query pacing and accepted row counts; actual query completions are recorded and may vary with latency. Matched aggregate budgets; CPU and RSS include broker and MinIO.

native_comparison.scope: Fixed deployment-shape, single-node API-accepted performance; different durability contracts
native_comparison.aggregation: median/min/max and raw values of three repetitions, no confidence intervals
